title: Fix street-level zoom error in CustomMapView

requirements.summary: Fix the error that occurs when zooming to street level on the community map by auditing and correcting tile URL computation, zoom level capping, and Web Mercator math in CustomMapView, useMapTiles, and useMapTransform
acceptanceCriteria: User can zoom from overview level all the way to street level (zoom 19) without any runtime error or crash.
Map tiles load correctly at all zoom levels up to 19.
No console errors related to tile URL construction or invalid zoom values.
Pan and zoom interactions remain smooth at maximum zoom level.
Zoom controls (in/out/out/reset) function correctly at all zoom levels including the maximum.

file_operations.description: Audit and fix Web Mercator coordinate-to-tile calculations to ensure they correctly handle zoom level 19. Verify that tile coordinate computations (tileX, tileY) are clamped to valid ranges for each zoom level (0 to 2^zoom - 1). Ensure the tile URL construction uses integer tile coordinates and does not pass out-of-bounds values to the CartoDB tile server. Add validation to prevent NaN or Infinity values in tile calculations.

Review and fix the zoom state management to ensure zoom level 19 is properly supported. Verify that coordinate sanitization correctly handles the valid Web Mercator latitude range (-85.0511 to 85.0511 degrees) and longitude range (-180 to 180 degrees) at all zoom levels including 19. Ensure that pan operations at maximum zoom do not produce invalid coordinates that break tile calculations. Add bounds checking to prevent zoom or pan operations from creating invalid map states.

Audit the map rendering logic to ensure it correctly handles zoom level 19 without errors. Verify that the viewport-to-tile coordinate conversion logic passes valid parameters to useMapTiles at all zoom levels. Add error boundaries or defensive checks to catch and log any tile rendering errors before they crash the component. Ensure that wheel zoom events correctly update the zoom level without exceeding the maximum supported zoom (19) or producing invalid tile requests. Test that pan and zoom interactions remain smooth and error-free at street level.
